description: Change an embed of a wiki page's scene (PM-1076) — its caption, the sites that may frame it, its term — keeping its link, so the sites that have it keep working. Only what you pass changes: an empty caption takes it off, an empty 'sites' allows any site, days 0 removes the term. Only for somebody who may edit the page; a line in its history.

caption.description: New caption; empty takes it off.

days.description: A new term in days from now; 0 is until it is removed.

embedId.description: The embed's id, from list_wiki_embeds or create_wiki_embed.

sites.description: Sites that may frame it, comma-separated; empty is any site.

name: update_wiki_embed
title: Update wiki embed
